summary.description: One short sentence (same language as the test) summarizing exactly what was changed. Shown to the user before they confirm.

name.description: The test's name. Copy the CURRENT name unchanged unless the instruction explicitly asked to rename/retitle it.

topic.description: The test's topic tag (2-4 hyphenated lowercase nouns). Copy the CURRENT topic unchanged unless the new content requires a different one.

desc.description: The test's description. Copy the CURRENT description unchanged unless the instruction explicitly asked to change it.

quizzes_to_add.description: Brand-new questions to append. Leave EMPTY unless the instruction explicitly asked to add question(s).

q.description: The question text. Use MathJax ($...$) for math expressions.

quizzes_to_remove_ids.description: IDs (copied verbatim from the current questions list below) of questions to delete. Leave EMPTY unless the instruction explicitly asked to remove question(s).

quizzes_to_update.description: Existing questions to modify in place. Include ONLY the questions the instruction actually asked to change - never rewrite untouched questions.

id.description: The id of the existing question being updated, copied verbatim from the current list.

q.description: The updated question text. Use MathJax ($...$) for math expressions.
